summary: Iteration 4 full test of new payment methods (Zelle / Test Card / disabled Square-PayPal-CashApp), server-side order pricing, admin payment-status flow, admin Home Banners CMS, 404 route, plus regression. Added new pytest module /app/backend/tests/test_payments_content.py (18 tests) — all pass; full backend suite 94/94 pass. Playwright covered: checkout payment picker + Zelle end-to-end, Test Card end-to-end, admin /admin/orders Mark Paid + Awaiting Payment filter + customer order page update, /admin/banners edit/publish/add/remove + home reflection + restore, 404 page and home/shop-filter/wishlist regression. No functional defects found.

minor.issue: Server enforces only a price FLOOR: a client-supplied item price ABOVE the DB/sale price is accepted verbatim (subtotal computed from it). Under-floor prices are correctly corrected, and client subtotal/total are ignored, so no revenue loss, but item pricing is not strictly server-authoritative.
PydanticDeprecatedSince20 warnings: .dict() used in price_cart (line 236) and create_order (line 878); switch to model_dump().

action_items: Optional: make item price fully server-authoritative in price_cart (use DB price instead of accepting any client price >= floor).
Optional: replace Pydantic .dict() with .model_dump() to clear deprecation warnings.
Optional: server.py is 1191 lines — split into routers (payments/orders/admin/content) for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: price_cart uses `price = it.price if it.price >= floor - 0.005 else floor` — inbound client price is trusted when higher than the floor; prefer DB price as source of truth.
reserve_stock/release_stock compensating logic is correct (atomic $inc with stock>=qty guard, release on payment failure) — verified via over-stock 409 test.
order_response correctly hides zelle block and re-derives timeline once paymentStatus != awaiting_payment; no _id leakage observed in any tested response.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created orders with shipping.firstName 'TEST' — all 37 leftover TEST orders deleted afterwards and product stock restored (product 14 stock now 97, reduced only by the 3 real UI checkout orders). Home content was modified and restored to seed values (verified via GET /api/content/home: 'Geek Bar Pulse 2 25K Grape Hubba' / '30K Puffs', 3 slides / 4 promo blocks). UI test orders left in DB: P2D-04036581 (Zelle, marked paid via admin), P2D-53856801 (Test Card).

One flaky failure observed once: tests/test_puff2door_full.py::TestGoogle::test_bogus_session (~1 of 2 full-suite runs, passed on rerun and in isolation) — likely transient ingress response; re-check if it recurs.
rca_of_the_issue: No product defects reproduced. The single flaky backend failure (TestGoogle::test_bogus_session expecting 401) did not reproduce on rerun (94/94 pass) and is attributed to a transient upstream/ingress response rather than app logic.
